name: Hoarfrost · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 6-block radius for 12 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ cold + 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Cold 63: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Rooted in place for 1.5 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
